scarlet-violet-temporal-forces-booster-b.title: Temporal Forces Booster Box
scarlet-violet-temporal-forces-booster-b.bodyHtml:
Command the Ages! Scarlet & Violet—Temporal Forces Booster Box!

Harness the power of the past and future with a factory-sealed Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Temporal Forces Booster Box! This electrifying expansion revisits the mysterious Paradox Pokémon, introducing ancient legends like Walking Wake and cutting-edge future forms like Iron Leaves. Prepare to encounter formidable Pokémon ex, new ACE SPEC cards, and stunning art that captures the essence of time itself!

This complete booster box is your ultimate opportunity to delve deep into the Temporal Forces set. Each pack is a portal to discovering powerful new strategies and collecting rare cards that will reshape your game. Whether you favor the primal strength of the past or the advanced tactics of the future, this set has something for every trainer.

What's Included in This Chrono-Bending Box:

  • 1x Factory-Sealed Pokémon TCG: Scarlet & Violet—Temporal Forces Booster Box: A full display unit, typically containing 36 booster packs, ready to be opened!

  • Multiple Booster Packs: Each pack contains 10 randomly assorted cards, including a guaranteed rare card and a code card for the Pokémon TCG Live.

  • Discover Ancient & Future Paradox Pokémon: Encounter unique forms of Pokémon that traverse time, bringing unprecedented power and strategic depth to your deck.

  • New ACE SPEC Cards: Experience the return of powerful ACE SPEC cards, offering game-changing effects that can turn the tide of any battle (limited to one per deck).

  • Powerful Pokémon ex & Illustration Rares: Pull highly sought-after Pokémon ex and beautifully illustrated rare cards that are both playable and collectible.

Journey back to where it all began with an incredibly rare and iconic piece of Pokémon TCG history! This is an authentic, sealed Pokémon Trading Card Game Base Set Unlimited Booster Pack, featuring the majestic Venusaur on its classic artwork. What makes this pack even more special for collectors is its "Long Crimp" sealing, a unique characteristic from early print runs that speaks to its vintage authenticity!

Why This Vintage "Long Crimp" Pack is a Collector's Dream:

  • The Origin Story: This is a sealed piece from the very first English Pokémon TCG expansion, the one that started it all! Every card inside is from the beloved Base Set, the foundation of the entire game.
  • Iconic Venusaur Art: The pack features the timeless artwork of Venusaur, one of the original Kanto starters, making it a visually striking display piece even while sealed.
  • The "Long Crimp" Distinction: For discerning collectors, the extended crimp seal on both ends of this pack is a clear indicator of its early production, adding significant appeal and rarity compared to later print runs. It's a genuine piece of TCG printing history!
  • The Ultimate Thrill of the Unknown: Each vintage pack contains 11 additional game cards, offering the tantalizing possibility of pulling a highly sought-after holographic Charizard, Blastoise, Venusaur, or another legendary card from the set that defined a generation. Will you be the one to unearth a hidden gem?
  • Nostalgia Overload: Whether you're chasing that elusive holographic Charizard, completing a vintage collection, or simply want to hold a piece of your childhood in your hands, opening (or preserving!) a Base Set pack is an unparalleled experience.
